dialogues.speaker: "Teteltetl"
dialogues.text: I am your loyal friend, "Teteltetl"! "Teteltetl" was once the ceremonial greeter of old Tenochtzitoc. Now I'm the greeter of this modern-day resort!

dialogues.speaker: "Teteltetl"
dialogues.text: Ohoho! This is a Nanas outfit! It was once a type of prickly pear native to the region... Unfortunately, no one's seen one in five hundred years.

dialogues.speaker: "Teteltetl"
dialogues.text: If you keep walking, you'll eventually run into someone dressed as a Nochtli. That's another type of prickly pear.

dialogues.speaker: "Teteltetl"
dialogues.text: If my memory serves me correctly, you're likely to find more of them in Villa Guiztli.
